jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

jobs.occupation: Security Pentester – Web Apps & Active Directory
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Perform penetration tests in black, grey, and white box modes on web applications, APIs, and administration portals.
• Conduct internal and external network infrastructure assessments focusing on segmentation, filtering, and protocol vulnerabilities.
• Execute security tests on Windows and Active Directory environments, including Kerberos, GPO, ACL, and lateral movement analysis.
• Analyze technical architectures and data flows to identify attack surfaces and critical assets.
• Document vulnerabilities and draft technical reports with detailed reproduction steps and remediation recommendations.
• Present findings to technical teams and project managers to assist in risk management.
• Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, including methodologies, check-lists, and tooling improvements.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in offensive security with a focus on web application and API testing using OWASP methodologies.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in network security and infrastructure protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, and SMB.
• You possess practical knowledge of Windows and Active Directory security, specifically regarding NTLM, Kerberos, and PowerShell.
• You're proficient with security tooling such as Kali Linux, Burp Suite, Nmap, and Metasploit.
• You have a solid understanding of modern authentication protocols like OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and JWT.
• You possess strong technical writing skills and the ability to work collaboratively with senior experts.
• You have active knowledge of French, Dutch, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CRTP.
• Experience with cloud environments like Azure, AWS, or GCP.
• Knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD security.
• Experience in mobile application security testing.

Responsibilities

• Evaluate backend and endpoint infrastructure to define upgrades, changes, and expansion proposals.
• Perform feasibility studies and evaluate hardware and software solutions to meet infrastructure needs.
• Develop technical designs aligned with specific architecture requirements for end-user devices.
• Implement hardware and software upgrades to support new projects and enhance existing systems.
• Provide high-level support and maintenance for the IT infrastructure following ITIL methodologies.
• Advise stakeholders on technical possibilities and limitations within the existing technology stack.
• Collaborate on improving procedures and workflows within the department and specific projects.

Requirements

• You have 10+ years of experience in system engineering within large-scale environments managing over 100,000 endpoints.
• You possess expert knowledge of Intune, including MDM, MAM, BYOD, Conditional Access Policies, and Enterprise Mobility + Security Suite.
• You bring in-depth expertise in System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), focusing on software management and task sequences.
• You're experienced with infrastructure stacks across Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
• You have deep knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP, and GPO management.
• You possess broad expertise in Azure, Office 365, and security tools like Windows Defender.
• You're proficient in scripting with PowerShell and VBScript.
• You have a strong understanding of networking protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.
• You hold a Bachelor's degree and certifications such as MCSA, MCSE, or MCSD.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with very good English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with ServiceNow and PM² methodologies.
• Knowledge of third-party MDM solutions like Knox or KAI.
• Familiarity with patching tools such as PatchMyPC.
• Proactive ability to maintain security processes and standards aligned with business objectives.

As an Asset Management Engineer for civil and structural assets, you strengthen the asset team at an industrial production site in Hoboken. Your focus is to help shape, implement and continuously improve the asset management approach for buildings, structures and related civil assets.

You work on tactical asset planning, maintenance strategy and lifecycle management. You collect and structure operational remarks, technical findings and improvement opportunities, and translate them into concrete proposals and follow-up actions.

You operate in an engineering environment that supports production across the full lifecycle of technical projects, from feasibility and design to realization and start-up. As asset management maturity is still evolving, you help define and embed practical working methods in daily operations.

• Support the design, implementation and rollout of the asset management system for civil and building assets.
• Help organize processes, asset registers, hierarchies, criticality models, maintenance logic, KPIs and documentation workflows.
• Translate asset management principles such as ISO 55000, lifecycle thinking and risk-based decision-making into practical methods for an industrial environment.
• Develop tactical plans to improve the reliability, safety and service life of buildings and structural assets.
• Create and refine multi-year maintenance plans and monitor relevant performance indicators.
• Translate risks, degradation insights and operational improvement opportunities into maintenance strategies, improvement actions and project proposals.
• Investigate degradation, deficiencies and incidents to control and reduce structural risks.
• Perform root cause analyses for recurring technical problems and structural shortcomings.
• Interpret inspection data, trends, degradation curves and remaining-life evaluations.
• Apply criticality and risk analysis methods to prioritize interventions and lifecycle actions.
• Define preventive and mitigating measures and convert them into practical maintenance strategies.
• Prepare interventions to an execution-ready level, including scope, technical descriptions, permits, safety conditions, materials, contractor input and planning constraints.
• Transfer complete work packages to the work coordinator and use execution feedback to improve future plans and strategies.
• Translate identified measures into practical civil and structural improvement actions.
• Define scope, risks, planning and budget for smaller interventions on buildings and structures.
• Coordinate contractors and condition-monitoring partners during engineering and execution.
• Provide technical direction, quality follow-up and documentation support for assigned interventions.
• Prepare project scope documents and CAPEX/OPEX proposals when required.
• Support design, review and handover so assets are inspectable, maintainable and reliable.
• Safeguard compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including ISO 55000, SEVESO and Eurocode where relevant.
• Ensure accurate and high-quality asset data management in EAM and DMS systems.
